Hi Brittany,

These steps will install the updated Sparkle Suite Live Queue extension with the Party Filter boxes.

Important: Please do these steps after your show, not while customers are watching.

1. Download the attached zip file.

2. Right-click the zip file and choose "Extract All".

3. Click "Extract".

4. Open Google Chrome.

5. In the address bar at the top, type:
   chrome://extensions

6. Press Enter.

7. In the top right, turn on "Developer mode".

8. Remove the old Sparkle Suite Live Queue extension if it is still there.

9. Click "Load unpacked".

10. Select the folder you extracted from the zip file.
    Important: Select the folder, not a single file.

11. Click "Select Folder".

12. Pin/open the Sparkle Suite icon.

13. Enter your sync code:
    BWB-5819

14. Go to your Bomb Party live party orders page:
    https://myoffice.bombparty.com/live-party-orders

15. Open the Sparkle Suite icon again.

16. You should now see "Party Filter" with checkboxes for the parties.

If you get stuck, stop there and Louis will help you on screen share.
